name: Gold (fear gauge)
summary: Gold near $3,873 on 16 Nov, down 14.8% over three months, beyond the 8% fall that marks Watch
state: Gold futures were near $3,873 early on 16 Nov, 14.8% lower over three months, 6.9% lower over a month and 3.9% lower on the week, beyond the 8% three-month fall that marks Watch (Yahoo Finance). The price is about 27% below its 52-week high of $5,318. The largest daily fall of the past five sessions was 2.9%, inside the 7% weekly Alert line.
for_you: A sharp fall in gold usually reflects shifting rate expectations and a stronger dollar; holders of gold see larger swings than usual.
why: Gold is the oldest crisis hedge; disorderly surges signal fear about currencies, inflation or geopolitics.
drivers: Real interest rates, central-bank buying, geopolitical fear, dollar moves.

rubric.alert: 3-month gain > 20%, or a single-week move > 7% either way.
